points.description: States the rule: the weight change of a synapse is proportional to the product of the error signal and the input signal at that synapse (Δw = η · e · x, or equivalent).
points.partial_credit: Half if only mentions error and input without the product/proportionality, or gives a vague update formula.

points.description: Explains that the rule is derived from / is based on steepest (gradient) descent, i.e. minimising the error (e.g. squared error / LMS).
points.partial_credit: Half if only says it reduces or minimises error without linking to gradient/steepest descent.

rubric.notes: Full marks: weight change proportional to error times input, plus mention that it comes from steepest/gradient descent (error minimisation), in any wording. Part marks for vague but relevant answers, e.g. a weight update depending on error only, or on minimising error without naming the method. No marks for unrelated rules (e.g. Hebbian only) or empty answers.
